s.en: suspend access to a filesystem (Ext3/4, ReiserFS, JFS, XFS)

o.en: This option requests the specified filesystem to be frozen from new modifications. When this is selected, all ongoing transactions in the filesystem are allowed to complete, new write(2) system calls are halted, other calls which modify the filesystem are halted, and all dirty data, metadata, and log information are written to…
This option is used to un-freeze the filesystem and allow operations to continue. Any filesystem modifications that were blocked by the freeze are unblocked and allowed to complete.
